...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in
Missouri...

Grand River near Chillicothe affecting Linn and Livingston
Counties.

Grand River near Sumner affecting Linn, Livingston, Chariton and
Carroll Counties.

* WHAT...Moderate flooding is occurring and moderate flooding is
forecast.

* WHERE...Grand River near Sumner.

* WHEN...Until late Saturday night.

* IMPACTS...At 23.0 feet, Bottomland 1 to 2 miles south of the gage
begins to flood. At 26.0 feet, Rural land adjacent to the river is
flooded. At 28.0 feet, Rural roads are under water.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 6:45 AM CST Thursday the stage was 29.9 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise to a crest of 30.9 feet
just after midnight tonight. It will then fall below flood stage
early Saturday morning.
- Flood stage is 26.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

This product along with additional weather and stream information is
available at www.weather.gov/kc/.
properties.area: Carroll, MO; Chariton, MO; Linn, MO; Livingston, MO

properties.title: Flood Warning issued November 5 at 5:59AM MST until November 7 at 2:00PM MST by NWS Phoenix AZ
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by upstream dam release continues.

* WHERE...Maricopa County in south central Arizona...

* WHEN...Until 200 PM MST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring. Low-water
crossings are inundated with water and may not be passable.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 559 AM MST, upstream floodgate release from Tempe Town Lake
and continued releases from Granite Reef Dam farther upstream has
lead to flooding in the warned area. A US Army Core of Engineers
streamflow gauge on the Gila River showed a flow near Old US 80
was around 14500 cfs.
- Flooding is occurring along the Salt and Gila Rivers.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Goodyear, Painted Rock Dam, Liberty, Phoenix International
Raceway and Arlington.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

properties.title: Flood Warning issued November 5 at 5:47AM MST until November 5 at 8:00PM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...Coconino County in north central Arizona...
Navajo County in north central Arizona...

* WHEN...Until 800 PM MST Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of the Little Colorado River is occurring.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 544 AM MST, a river gauge on the Little Colorado River at
Winslow had dropped below action stage. Water levels are forecast
to continue to fall through today, however flooding will remain a
threat downstream at Birdsprings through this evening.
- For Little Colorado at Winslow:
At 5:00am MST the stage was 16.56 feet.
Flood Stage is 19.0 feet.
Impacts:
At 17.0 feet: Downstream, the approaches to the bridge over the
river on Navajo Route 71 near Bird Springs will flood, and Leupp
will be within 3 feet of flooding problems. The river will crest
at Navajo Route 71 approximately 18 hours after the river crests
at Winslow. Minor lowland overflow on right bank at Winslow.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Leupp, Birdsprings, Sunrise and Homolovi Ruins State Park.
- Additional information is available at weather.gov/flagstaff.
properties.instruction:
Stay away or be swept away! The banks of creeks and washes are
unstable and unsafe during any flooding event.

Low water crossings will become dangerous in heavy rain. Do not
attempt to cross flooded roads. Find an alternate route.
